contexts.text: The Rational is called a cedar in Lebanon ().
Tree of fruit () = the celestial man; cedar = the spiritual man.
Lebanon () stands for cedars, which = spiritual things, or the truths of faith.
The cedar shall he made bare () = intellectual truth.
Self-love is described by cedars, etc. (), which are lofty.
The rational things (of the celestial man) are compared to a forest of cedars and similar trees, such as were on Lebanon.
The Church, whose celestial spiritual things are the glory of Lebanon, or cedars ().
The Assyrian and a cedar () = the Rational. AC 2831:6.
To cut him out windows and planked with cedar and painted with vermilion () = to falsify intellectual and spiritual truths.
Cedars () = rational things.
The evil of self-love is described by the height of the cedars, and the strength of the oaks ().
Wood of cedar () = internal spiritual truth; hyssop, external; thus by cedar is signified an interior means of purification; by hyssop, an exterior one.
Palm () = good; cedar, truth.
The cedars of Lebanon which (the bramble) would consume () = the truths of good.
The glory of Lebanon, or the cedar () = spiritual good and truth.
Shittim wood was the wood of the most excellent cedar; and by a cedar is signified the Spiritual of the Church. (Under Shittim wood, see this reference.)
The Assyrian () = an enlightened Rational; a cedar in Lebanon = the spiritual Church; the height of it = the degree of good.
Lebanon () = the spiritual Church; a cedar here = the truth of the spiritual Church.
The cedar and the wood of oil are mentioned (), because the cedar = spiritual good, and the wood of oil, celestial good; spiritual good is charity towards the neighbour...
By the olive, vine, cedar, poplar, and oak are meant the good and truth of the Church, celestial, spiritual, rational, natural, and sensual.
By the cedars and Lebanon, which He will break () are meant the falsities of the rational man.
With the ancients... the cedar = rational good and truth.
The cedars of Lebanon () = the Knowledges of truth; hence it is said that the voice of Jehovah will make them skip like a calf.
(A temple seen with a floor of cedar.)
I saw a cedar table on which was (the Divine Love and Wisdom).

The Assyrian is here called a cedar in Lebanon (), because a cedar has the same signification as the Assyrian; specifically, the truth from good therein; and Lebanon = the mind where it is, because on Lebanon there were cedars.
A magnificent cedar () = the spiritual Church.
The cedar of Shittah () = genuine truth.
A cedar () = the truth of the spiritual Church.
Those things of the Church which are in the spiritual or internal man are signified by the cedar of Shittah, etc. ().
The Assyrian () = the Rational; and a cedar, the Intellectual.

#preserve #216 the appended topic is fully covered in surrounding references, and can be ignored, since it's not worth any further effort trying to squeeze it in. Hence, this reference is hereto adjoined. @--[28]. The growth of the Rational through scientific truths and Knowledges, is described by "a cedar in Lebanon" (Ezekiel 31:3-9), by which also the Rational is signified.
#separator

contexts.text: The cedars of God () = spiritual truths.
Lebanon () = the spiritual Church; and the cedars = its internal truths which are from good...
By the cedars of Lebanon, and the oaks of Bashan () is signified conceit from man's Own intelligence; interior conceit, by the cedars of Lebanon; and exterior, by the oaks of Bashan.
Palm () = spiritual good; cedar, the truth of that good; and Lebanon the spiritual Church.
Cedars, in the Word, are predicated of the rational man; and oaks, of the natural.
Lign aloes () = those things which are of the natural man; cedars, those things which are of the rational man.
The cedars of Lebanon () = the rational things which are from truths.
The cedar which He has made bare = the Rational destroyed.
A cedar () = the Rational of the man of the Church which is from a spiritual origin.
The cedar (of Shittah) = higher rational truth; the myrtle, lower rational truth.
Oaks, and cedars of Lebanon () = Knowledges of good and truth in the external sense, and in the internal.
A cedar here (), as elsewhere in the Word = the spiritual rational Church, such as the Church with the ancients after the flood.
Wood from... the cedar = rational good.
